# Keyset pagination with compound sort keys — facts

> Source-anchored units about Keyset pagination with compound sort keys: 7 across 6 sources. Each line ends in the URL and anchor it came from; `keywords:` names the lexicon terms that matched.

## Definitions

- [statement] Although _id is a useful unique tie-breaker, an ObjectId is not a strict clock: MongoDB notes that ObjectIds have one-second timestamp resolution and client clocks can differ. For chronological feeds, sort on an explicit timestamp followed by _id. (medium confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.skip/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys · also: https://blog.openreplay.com/pagination-patterns-mongodb/

## How it works

- [statement] Keyset paging is less affected than offset paging by inserts or deletes before the current boundary because it anchors to values, but it is not snapshot-consistent. Concurrent changes or updates to mutable sort fields can make items appear twice or be missed. Prefer immutable sort fields and a unique tie-breaker when walking a changing collection. (medium confidence) — https://blog.openreplay.com/pagination-patterns-mongodb/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys · also: https://github.com/tawk/mongo-cursor-pagination, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.skip/, https://www.codevra.org/mongodb/mongodb-keyset-pagination, https://www.mongodb.com/community/forums/t/ensuring-consistency-in-pagination-for-frequently-updated-collections/275182

## How-to and procedures

- [statement] Use a compound index whose sort-key fields appear in the same order, with directions matching the index pattern or its full inverse. Equality-prefix fields can precede those keys only when the query constrains each prefix field by equality. Inspect explain as well: a multi-key $or boundary can prevent one index from efficiently serving both the range filter and requested sort in some query plans. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/tutorial/sort-results-with-indexes/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys · also: https://brianp.de/posts/2024/mongodb-cursor-pagination-multiple-fields/, https://www.codevra.org/mongodb/mongodb-keyset-pagination, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.sort/, https://github.com/tawk/mongo-cursor-pagination

## Problems, failure modes and limitations

- [statement] A compound lexicographic $or can still yield a poor plan. In one MongoDB case study, a find() predicate using a > cursorA OR (a == cursorA AND b > cursorB) with sort({a: 1, b: 1}) did not efficiently combine index filtering with ordered retrieval; the author used a staged aggregation to position near the cursor before applying the full boundary. This case report does not establish a general MongoDB limitation. (low confidence) — https://brianp.de/posts/2024/mongodb-cursor-pagination-multiple-fields/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys

## Facts and statements

- [statement] Treat the sort tuple as the cursor position. For sort {createdAt: -1, _id: -1}, the next-page boundary is createdAt < lastCreatedAt OR (createdAt == lastCreatedAt AND _id < lastId). For more keys, compare the first differing key after matching preceding keys for equality, using the comparison direction that matches that key's sort direction. (high confidence) — https://blog.openreplay.com/pagination-patterns-mongodb/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys · also: https://brianp.de/posts/2024/mongodb-cursor-pagination-multiple-fields/, https://www.codevra.org/mongodb/mongodb-keyset-pagination, https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.skip/
- [statement] Sort fields that can tie need a unique final key to define a repeatable page boundary, often _id. MongoDB documents that tied sort keys can be returned in any relative order; MongoDB examples and implementations add _id after a timestamp or other paginated field. The unique tuple defines a deterministic order for a fixed dataset, but it does not create a snapshot across requests. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.sort/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys · also: https://blog.openreplay.com/pagination-patterns-mongodb/, https://github.com/tawk/mongo-cursor-pagination, https://medium.com/mongodb/mongodb-pagination-offset-based-vs-keyset-vs-pre-generated-result-pages-4177e05d88ec
- [statement] An indexed keyset range boundary avoids walking the prefix that skip() must pass, so it typically scales better for deep sequential pages. It does not guarantee constant latency or a universal O(log n) page cost: filters and the selected plan still matter, and a literal multi-key $or form may filter or sort inefficiently. (high confidence) — https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/reference/method/cursor.skip/ · keywords: Keyset pagination with compound sort keys · also: https://medium.com/mongodb/mongodb-pagination-offset-based-vs-keyset-vs-pre-generated-result-pages-4177e05d88ec, https://brianp.de/posts/2024/mongodb-cursor-pagination-multiple-fields/, https://www.codevra.org/mongodb/mongodb-keyset-pagination, https://blog.openreplay.com/pagination-patterns-mongodb/
